app.title: Corpus
app.tagline: A translation workbench for structured text
home.emptyMaintainer: Create a project, then push your repository's text into it from its root:
home.emptyTranslator: A maintainer creates a project and pushes the repository's text into it. There is nothing to translate until then.
switcher.label: Select a project
catalogue.heading: Catalogue
catalogue.empty: No strings yet. Push a snapshot to populate this project.
entities.heading: Entities
entities.empty: No entities yet. Push a snapshot that includes them.
settings.heading: Settings
settings.errorInvalid: Check the fields: languages are codes such as pt-PT.
settings.errorLastMaintainer: The instance needs at least one maintainer.
settings.tokenIntro: The CLI pushes with a per-project token. Rotating it invalidates the old one at once.
settings.tokenOnce: Copy this token now. It is shown once and disappears after a minute.
settings.languagesIntro: The source language is {language} and cannot change here.
settings.targetLanguagesHint: Language codes separated by commas, such as pt-PT, en.
settings.historyIntro: Every push from the CLI, newest first.
settings.historyEmpty: No pushes yet. Run corpus push from the project's repository.
settings.usersIntro: Everyone who joined with the invite secret. Maintainers verify strings and change settings.
settings.resetDone: Temporary password for {name}. Copy it now: it is shown once, their sessions have ended, and they will choose a new password at sign-in.
string.archived: This string is archived. It is read-only.
editor.proofreading: Proofreading the source ({language}). Translations are edited from the untranslated and stale queues.
verify.errorGeneric: This string could not be verified.
verify.warningChanged: This string changed since you opened it. Your sign-off applied to the latest version.
editor.errorInvalid: That translation was not saved: its placeholders or selects do not match the source.
editor.errorEmpty: Nothing to save: the translation is empty.
editor.errorSourceRow: The source text comes from the repository and is not edited here.
editor.insertSelect: Insert a select on {arg} with the keys {keys}
editor.staleBanner: The source text changed after this translation was saved. Check it against the source above, then save again.
editor.unknownSelect: The source has no select on {arg}
invite.heading: New here? Join with the invite secret
invite.intro: The instance invite secret lets you in once. Pick the display name your colleagues will see and a password of your own.
invite.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A sentence works well.
invite.errorInvalid: That invite secret was not accepted, or the name is empty.
invite.errorCredentials: That name and password were not accepted.
invite.errorNameTaken: That name is taken. Sign in above, or pick another.
invite.errorWeakPassword: That password is too short. Use at least eight characters.
invite.errorRateLimited: Too many failed attempts. Try again in about {minutes} minutes.
newProject.heading: New project
newProject.slugHint: The short name in the project's address, such as moonlight-manor: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It cannot change later.
newProject.name: Name
newProject.nameHint: Shown to translators wherever the project is listed.
newProject.sourceLanguageHint: The language the repository's text is written in, as a code such as pt-PT.
newProject.languagesHint: Every language the project carries, the source language included, as codes separated by commas.
newProject.tokenOnce: Copy this push token now. It is shown only once.
newProject.errorInvalid: Check the fields: the slug is lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, languages are codes such as pt-PT, and they must include the source language.
notFound.heading: Page not found
notFound.description: This page does not exist. Check the address or go back home.
password.heading: Choose a new password
password.introReset: A maintainer reset your password. The temporary one you signed in with stops working once you save your own.
password.intro: Your new password replaces the current one on every device.
